summary: The note describes the Hero of Socialist Labour, an honorary title in Albania (and other Warsaw Pact countries) that was the highest distinction for exceptional achievements in the national economy and culture. It is presented as parallel to the People's Hero of Albania title, which was for heroic deeds, whereas this title recognized contributions to industry, agriculture, transportation, trade, science and technology, and promoting Albania's might and glory.
one_line: Hero of Socialist Labour was Albania's highest honorary title for exceptional contributions to the national economy and culture.
key_facts: Hero of Socialist Labour was an honorary title in Albania and other Warsaw Pact countries.
The title was the highest degree of distinction for exceptional achievements in national economy and culture.
The title provided a similar status to the title People's Hero of Albania.
People's Hero of Albania was awarded for heroic deeds.
Hero of Socialist Labour was awarded to citizens who contributed to the development of Albania's industry.
Recipients contributed to the development of Albania's agriculture.
Recipients contributed to the development of Albania's transportation and trade.
Recipients contributed to the development of Albania's science and technology.
Recipients promoted the might and the glory of Albania.
Unlike People's Hero of Albania, the Hero of Socialist Labour was awarded for economic and cultural contributions rather than heroic deeds.
